scope: Goal mode and BTW integration into the product host. Existing unrelated worktree changes preserved.

goal: InteractiveMode goal commands and continuation scheduling

checks.note: Includes 10 goal and 6 BTW tests. Six existing opt-in real sandbox checks were skipped.

checks.environment: Task-owned PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and XDG data/state/cache directories; no personal configuration

humanConstraints.before: Two actual TUI goal scenarios failed: automatic continuation and pause/resume replaced the latest human restriction with NEED_CONTINUATION.
humanConstraints.after: Both pass; cold command and native-menu resumes still restore an empty review context.

regressionEvidence.shutdownRace: A real native goal retirement previously stranded input registration after close. The optional abort signal now terminates before or during the wait; regression passes.
regressionEvidence.toolSelection: Actual TUI pause/completion restores the prior controlled tool set even after goal_updated cleared the enabled flag.

review.scope: Goal/BTW integration and the associated SDK and input-loop changes, not the entire dirty worktree.
repairs: Closing during native goal retirement cannot strand the input loop.
Cold goal command/menu resume restores review context.
Continuation and same-process resume preserve newer human restrictions.
review.note: The five independently rerun product regressions are included in the 228 product passes; counts must not be added together.

terminalSmoke.mode: Actual PTY and product CLI, offline --demo with task-owned temporary home
passed: Idle /goal set submits the objective and displays active goal status.
Automatic continuation starts a further demo response.
/goal budget 10000 changes the displayed budget; /goal pause displays paused state.
/btw shows the native side panel; Escape closes it and bare /btw opens saved history.
/quit exits with code zero and prints a product resume command.
The printed resume command reopens a paused goal and retained BTW history without automatic goal execution.
Explicit /goal resume restarts continuation; pause and quit work afterward.

boundaries: Native goal registration is opt-in within restricted sessions; unrelated native tools and discovery remain restricted.
Models can inspect/complete an existing goal, but cannot create, replace, resume or drop it or change its budget.
Goal is unavailable in light mode; plan mode cannot start/resume goals. Both new slash commands require TUI.
BTW may carry tool schemas for prompt caching but does not execute tool calls or append questions/answers to the main transcript.
Native branch promotion remains blocked by product session lifecycle checks.
Goal token budget follows native usage accounting and is not a provider-side hard spending cap.
limitations: No live OpenCode Go model, Tavily or remote MCP calls.
Goal completion quality, long task behavior and service limits still require real-model trial.
Six existing real OS sandbox checks were not rerun.
No full upstream/Rust suite, cross-platform packaging, GUI or human acceptance.
The native inline BTW footer can still display a branch shortcut even though product branch promotion is refused.
artifacts: Raw test logs are retained in the parent workspace artifacts directory. This record contains no credentials or personal conversation bodies.
